budget_note: This is a declared overrun of the 3-experiment budget in the parallel-run protocol, logged as irregularity IR-H82-02. Justification: protocol rule 2 says to REUSE the template's cached feature stack. E1-E3 deliberately used only the 19 shipped bands plus nine derivatives, so a negative lane verdict could have been an artefact of a thin stack rather than of the hypothesis. E4 repeats the SAME arms on the full mirrored stack (20 extra channels: 3DEP lidar scarp morphology, GeoDAWN radiometrics) and introduces no new hypothesis, no new tuning parameter and no new allocator setting.

arms.B_std_nms_sep3: 19+9 channels, crest-thinned, min_sep 3.0 (best arm so far)

decision_rule: The build surface is the arm with the highest pooled HOLDOUT-DTI that also wins on the seed-30 replication with a paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 against its own nearest control. Whatever the result, the lane's primary hypothesis stays REFUTED: E2 already settled it on two seeds.

They are integrity-pinned, NOT organizer-authenticated, and this session did not re-derive them from the primary sources (those hosts are unreachable from this sandbox).
